licence_note: BioCLIP 2 is released under the MIT licence (model card 'License: MIT'; LICENSE file at the address given); keep the notice
recipe_how: onnxruntime.quantization.quantize_dynamic: MatMul and Gemm with constant weights, weight_type QInt8, per_channel=True, reduce_range=False, MatMulConstBOnly; activations quantized at run time (DynamicQuantizeLinear + MatMulInteger)

output.name: image_embeds
output.note: normalize to unit length before the dot products

preprocessing.resize: shortest side to 224, the other side int(224 * long / short) (truncated), bicubic with antialiasing (torchvision Resize on a PIL image, i.e. PIL's BICUBIC)
preprocessing.crop: centre 224 x 224: left = round((W - 224) / 2), top = round((H - 224) / 2) with halves rounded to even (Python round, as torchvision CenterCrop)
preprocessing.crop_rule_checked: the rule reproduced the transforms' output on 320 of 320 photos
preprocessing.scale: RGB; v / 255, then (v - mean) / std per channel; NCHW

runtime: onnxruntime-web 1.30.0, WASM backend (single thread unless the page is cross-origin isolated)

measured.about: species scored with tools/fusion/fuse.py against the published server rows (slot pub/heads-sentences-bioclip2-l14@6b69b6dd532d) with its fusion settings and the month prior; cosine is to the original model's published vectors (pub/lab-bioclip2-l14 images/alachua-2025.f16.npy)
measured.rule: fastest (median single-thread ms) of the recipes within one point of the original's top-1 with mean cosine >= 0.99

join: fetch the parts in order and concatenate them; the result's bytes and sha256 are those above
